tagline: Compress images to reduce file size without visible quality loss
pageDescription: Compress JPG, PNG and WebP images to shrink their file size with this free online Image Compressor. Drag the quality slider to balance size against sharpness and see exactly how much you saved — typically 50–80% smaller. Everything runs locally in your browser, so your images are never uploaded and stay private. Ideal for faster websites, smaller email attachments and staying under upload limits. No signup, no watermarks, no file-size paywall.

instructions.title: How to compress an image

steps.title: Upload your image
steps.description: Drag and drop an image onto the upload area or click to browse. Its current size is shown.

steps.title: Set the quality
steps.description: Drag the quality slider. Lower quality means a smaller file; around 70% is a good balance for most photos.

steps.title: Choose the output format
steps.description: Keep the original format, or convert to JPG or WebP for stronger compression. WebP usually wins.

steps.title: Compress the image
steps.description: Click Compress image. It processes in your browser — nothing is uploaded.

steps.title: Check savings and download
steps.description: See the before/after size and percentage saved, then download the smaller file.
